x: The closing stages were most exciting in both individual and team race, and we received great help when the two Essex Beagles, Abel and Everard, overhauled S.W.C. walkers in the last two miles.
Abel, who was with the Canadians when they visited us at Belgrave Hall in February, 1942. Abel was first man home for the Canadians, and was presented with a Club Spoon as a momento.
By the end of the first leg Tony had moved through to 12th with Pat a steady 4th in the M60's behind Spink of Bingley, Abel of Stonemasters, and only 13 seconds behind Wood of Barnet.
